about: Golden set for #104 (docs/assembly.md). Each entry: a real LCSC part, JLCPCB's own (EasyEDA) footprint for it recorded in easyeda/<lcsc>.json, the KiCad library footprint it is paired with (kicad7.pretty), and the answer decided by hand, independently of ecadlib.assembly: 'correction' is the degrees JLCPCB's CPL needs added to the KiCad board angle (Assembly Rotation), 'pads' the expected pad verdict. 'how' says how the answer was decided. 'evidence': jlc-footprint (read off JLCPCB's footprint drawing: pin 1 / cathode mark / pin names, rendered with visual_check), jlc-preview (seen in JLCPCB's placement preview), community (published preview evidence).

parts.how: R0402: pad 1 left on both; KiCad pads 1.02 mm apart against 0.87 mm on JLCPCB's: the r/KiCad 0402 rejection (+18%)
ferrite bead L0603: pad 1 left on both
red LED: JLCPCB numbers the cathode pad 2 (symbol pin 2 = K) and draws it on the left with the arrow-shaped silk; KiCad's cathode (pad 1) is on the left: no turn
green LED: JLCPCB's pad 1 = C (cathode), on the left, chamfered silk corner and bar on that end; KiCad's cathode on the left: no turn
SOIC-8 ...-BL: JLCPCB's pin 1 bottom-left, numbers running right; KiCad's pin 1 top-left, numbers running down; kicad-jlcpcb-tools saw 270 in JLCPCB's preview
blue LED 19-217: JLCPCB's pad 1 = C (cathode), on the left; KiCad's cathode (pad 1) on the left: no turn
red LED 17-21 (0805): JLCPCB numbers the cathode pad 2 (pin K) and draws it on the left; KiCad's cathode (pad 1) on the left: no turn
